row.notes: (state, lap) Fills the lap-positions table at state+0xc820 (stride 0x18 per lap, byte per car): for lap 0 the grid position (vehicle +0x90 ^ +0x98) +1; for lap n collects each car's lap time (Sess_LapTimes_GetCarData +0x40/+0x48 + lap*200), sorts (0x142dd87d0) and writes 1-based positions; max lap +0xc81c. Feeds packet LapPositions. Callers Game_TelemetryUdp_UpdateRace, UDP preferences changed, Sess_ViewInstantReplay_Update.
